name: Shuumatsu Shoujo Gensou Alicematic
original_name: 終末少女幻想アリスマチック
source:
In 2022, the world is afflicted with a mysterious phenomenon. Adjoining multi-dimension world assimilates and becomes another space, dimension assimilation phenomenon called "Petulation". Humans can't approach these areas and their number keeps increasing...

One day, Kuroudo receives summons from the government to help the related scientific investigation at Shin Shinonome Academy located on the newly reclaimed land in Tokyo bay.

He has no idea what is going on. But the world gets closer to the destruction little by little. All he has is his skill of swordplay and one sword.

There he meets others, whom just like him are destined to fight for the future of mankind...
translation:
2022年，世界遭到一种神秘现象侵袭。相邻的多维世界发生同化，转化为另一种空间。这种维度同化现象被称为“Petulation”。人类无法接近这些区域，而它们的数量仍在不断增加……

一天，藏人收到政府征召，前往东京湾新填海地上的新东云学园，协助相关科学调查。

他完全不知道发生了什么。然而，世界正一点一点走向毁灭。他拥有的，只有一身剑术与一柄刀。

在那里，他遇见了其他人。和他一样，他们也注定要为人类的未来而战……
